zh-CN.title: 回声唱片铺
items: 分享或听完周杰伦、王力宏、陶喆、林俊杰的歌曲，赢取歌手气泡，收藏可试听的专辑封面。
空间管理员可在活动管理中领取，活动从领取日起持续 30 天。

en.title: Echo Record Shop
items: Share or finish listening to songs by Jay Chou, Wang Leehom, David Tao, or JJ Lin to unlock artist bubbles and collect playable album covers.
Space admins can claim the event in Activity Management. It runs for 30 days from the time it is claimed.
